argv:
import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); start=int(sys.argv[2]); end=int(sys.argv[3]); paths=json.loads(sys.argv[4]); out=sys.stdout.buffer
page=(root/"SKILL.md").read_bytes(); lines=page.splitlines(keepends=True)
out.write(("SKILL SECTION %d-%d\n"%(start,end)).encode()); out.write(b"".join(lines[start-1:end])); out.write(b"\n")
for rel in paths:
 data=(root/rel).read_bytes(); out.write(("\nSOURCE "+rel+" sha256="+hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()+"\n").encode()); out.write(data); out.write(b"\n")
receipts.provenance: L1-author source re-anchoring only, not blind/independent cold-read or required-command coverage
